_README: Watchtower config for your own Pudge deployments. Run: node ckb-monitor.mjs --net testnet --watch watchlist.testnet.json --serve [--webhook https://hooks.slack...]. Each watch alerts when a matching tx appears, and (if idleMin is set) fires a SILENT alarm when none has appeared for that many minutes. Fill the 0x... placeholders from each project's DEPLOY/TESTNET doc, then remove "disabled": true.

watches.name: liquid-cells-sequencer
watches.desc: checkpoint advances; a stall is an incident
watches._paste: type = the Liquid Cells anchor type-id code hash (codeHash) from Liquid-Cells/DEPLOY.md (memory prefix 0x83158549...). Set, then drop disabled.

watches.name: xada-token
watches._paste: typeArgs = the χADA xUDT owner-lock hash (the xUDT type script args) from BRIDGE_STATUS.md. Or set type to the χADA mint code hash to catch mints only.

watches.name: deployer-funds
watches.desc: alert when the deployer lock spends/receives (watch your funding cell)
watches._paste: address = your deployer ckt1... address, or lockArgs = its lock args.
